response.justification: The candidate lacks any demonstrable C++ experience in professional contexts beyond a brief role at National Instruments 10 years ago, and shows no evidence of expertise in industrial automation, IEC 62443, secure development lifecycle, message brokers, or multi-threaded C++ systems — all core requirements for the role. Their recent work is exclusively in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with no cloud or industrial IoT exposure.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across diverse technologies and domains
Strong open-source contributions and technical communication skills
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and create educational content
concerns: No recent or relevant C++ development experience for industrial systems
Lacks exposure to industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) and SDL
No demonstrated experience with message brokers, MQTT, or real-time embedded systems
